newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real slips 0.06 pct by close in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real slips 0.06 pct by close in calm trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.06 percent to close at 1.0507 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.

The real was traded between 1.0500 and 1.0502 per dollar throughout most of the session. In the late afternoon, the market grew a little more active as some banks sought dollars to cover short positions, dealers said.
In the floating exchange rate market, the real closed at 1.0555 per dollar, up 0.02 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended steady at 1.085 per dollar, traders said.
